clauses.quote: the WTU Building Representative shall have the right to invoke STEP 1 of the grievance and arbitration procedure.
the office of the Chancellor shall immediately review all documentation related to the excessing of the WTU Building Representative for procedural compliance, violations, and fair practices.

The Building representative and the WTU shall be provided copies of all documentation related to the excessing of the affected Building Representative immediately upon request to the supervisor or Chancellor.
clauses.subject_text: The Building representative and the WTU

clauses.quote: The office of the Chancellor shall provide the Building Representative and the WTU a copy of the Chancellor’s findings and decision in writing within ten (10) business days of receipt of the request for review.
DCPS in transferring ET-15, ET15/12, ET15/11 and EG-09 employees shall apply the policy hereinafter set forth.
clauses.subject_text: DCPS in transferring ET-15, ET15/12, ET15/11 and EG-09 employees
clauses.notes: Mandates policy application during specific employee transfers.

clauses.quote: A Teacher shall be eligible to apply for a voluntary transfer annually.
Lists of vacancies, to the extent known, shall be prepared and posted on or before April 1 annually.
clauses.subject_text: Lists of vacancies, to the extent known

clauses.quote: The vacancy list shall be posted by the Supervisor in all schools and offices where Teachers of the bargaining unit are located
clauses.notes: Split from compound sentence joined by 'and'.

clauses.quote: a copy shall be provided To the WTU Building Representative.
clauses.notes: Split from compound sentence joined by 'and'.

clauses.quote: The Director of Human Resources shall provide a copy of the vacancy list, along with position descriptions to the President of the Washington Teachers’ Union.
Position descriptions shall be provided to bargaining unit Teachers upon request from the Human Resources Division when available.
Requests for transfers will be honored to the extent they do not conflict with law, instructional requirements, and/or the best interest of the school system.
clauses.notes: Conditional phrase limits the scope of the entitlement.

clauses.quote: The supervisor(s) of a Teacher requesting a voluntary transfer shall not in any way impede the transfer by making false statements or providing false information.
clauses.subject_text: The supervisor(s) of a Teacher requesting a voluntary transfer
